caption: Condition to complete the Forest: Stump
content: Some stumps @T{forest_gate.r} are placed outside the Area. All those stumps must sprout.
The conditions under which stumps sprout are explained in detail on the page @g{rule/complete_block/stump}{the stump condition to complete Areas}.

content.caption: Failed example
content: The stump outside the Area has not sprouted.
